title: Funktional
notes:
There is no need to introduce the Berlin producer Ash Cawlin any longer.
Funktional is his first digital studio album and like a hidden insider..s tip in regard of the "perfect minimalism" music style. A spectrum of sounds, which loop and repeat quite often. Others appear only once and significant. So the sound becomes a structurewise tension between improvisation and loop, between repeating and singular sensation. The space of these activities is coming from special rangy, reticular and dark grooves, which are producing a constantly movement. Determination and aimlessness , directness and mystery are facing each other very straight and direct. A more empathic hassle with club sound and music in general is hardly conceivable. With this kind of sound you can feel very clear, that Ash Cawlin is convincing with his deep and mystic trademark groove, which becomes not boring on any time. With the album "Funktional" the artist Ash Cawlin proves his quality as a top and successful producer.

title: Set On Destroy
notes:
"When Don Giovanni Records started in 2003, one major goal for the label was to foster a greater sense of awareness of bands from New Brunswick in an effort to get them heard and their music distributed beyond the local scene and area. Before that goal, or the label, even developed, co-founder Joe Steinhardt was dying to put out the first full length by Stormshadow, a short-lived New Brunswick punk band who provided a microcosmic look into much of what was, and has continued to be, so great about the New Brunswick, NJ punk scene. 
Previously available exclusively via a limited run of CD-Rs, which the band made to sell at their last show, Stormshadow’s Set On Destroy has finally been issued. The album's 16 tracks are mostly under 2 minutes each, all tight hardcore punk with scream-along melodies, dissonant riffs, and lyrics that mix the political with the personal. The record opens with "Switched On", a quick intro to the record's tendency to make unexpected turns from harsh hardcore screams to melodic pop-punk lines. "Watson Break" recalls the most vital aspects of sing-song anti-authoritarian folk-punk, while "Stainless Stealing & the Wage Gap" is an aggressive and honest discussion of economic injustice that could have been the soundtrack to the Occupy movement marches of fall 2011, asking "Profit over people, what is life's value?" then reminding that "the real war is for the mind" and concluding: "Life shouldn't be so cheap / never ever accept defeat." Like the other tracks presented here, though written and recorded over a decade ago, its energy feels just as pressing in 2013.  Set On Destroy is angry and anthemic throughout, a distillation of what's always so empowering about this breed of explosive music."

title: Strumm EP
notes:
Trioen Strumm har været ét af de mest omtalte usignede undergrundsorkestre her i landet i en rum tid nu - og når man lægger øre til debut-cd'en Strumm EP (Morningside Records) forstår man så udmærket hvorfor. Vel trækker disse fem numre, der er blevet produceret af Uffe Lauesen, Signe Høirup Wille-Jørgensen fra Speaker Bite Me og Jomi Massage samt gruppen selv, i høj grad på Sonic Youths forrevne støjrock-lyd: Den interne balance i gruppen er endda til en vis grad den samme, da det gerne er fyrene - guitaristerne Johannes Gammelby og Dennis Block - der tager sig af de mere ligefremme numre, mens sangerinden/trommeslageren Stine Sørensen tager sig af det mere aggressive og/eller mærkelige materiale. Hvem sagde Thurston Moore og Lee Ranaldo versus Kim Gordon?

Så meget sagt er Strumm på ingen måde et rip-off - på den frembrusende "…At Your Feet" og den overordentligt smukke "Darkmatters", der kombinerer kantede guitarer med psykedelisk svævende keyboard-mønstre og effekter, demonstrerer bandet f.eks. en popsensibilitet, der stort set er ukendt for forbillederne. Men også den rastløst drømmende "Neverwhere", den tordnende, bidske "Test Drive" samt den kuperede "Habit Holes", der veksler mellem skønsang, messende riffs og kontant larmende breaks, rummer en tone og et signal, der ganske vist tydeligt har sine kilder - men som også har et selvstændigt format. Dét og så den dejligt kontrastfylde produktion, der ubesværet bevæger sig fra det tørre og øvelokale-agtige til det endeløst bølgende, er alt sammen med til at gøre Strumm EP til om ikke det mest originale, man har hørt i Danmark på det seneste - lige på dét punkt er konkurrencen heldigvis benhård for tiden - så i hvert fald en stram og dynamisk debutudgivelse, der åbner for usædvanligt mange muligheder. "The world's at your feet", synges der på ep'ens første nummer. I sagde det selv, folkens.

De kommende måneder skulle i øvrigt gerne byde på den 7" med Strumm, der allerede er gået hen og blevet et nærmest mytisk væsen i flere kredse - men indtil da kan man med fordel fordrive tiden med at bestille dette næppe på nogen måder mindre spændende udspil på www.morningsiderecords.dk.
Steffen B. Pedersen, Geiger.dk 1/8 2003
